title: Pubnet transaction with PRECOND_V2 extraSigners: two signed-payload keys and a maxLedger bound
why: The transaction's preconditions name two ed25519 signed-payload signers (P… strkeys with 28-byte payloads) as extraSigners and bound it to ledger 65437036. Readers that cannot decode signed-payload signer keys in preconditions, or that truncate a P… strkey, fail on an ordinary pubnet envelope; readers that index the signers or the failed payment's accounts as participants are wrong.

values.note: Two signed-payload keys, payload 28 bytes each.

must_not_include.because: operation source and destination of a path payment that failed; none of its entries changed

known_divergences.detail: A MEMO_TEXT with non-ASCII bytes is written as \xNN escapes (four characters per byte), longer than the schema's maxLength 28 for string<28>; the JSON still reads back to the same bytes.

notes: Apply index 61 of 294; envelope phase 0 txs[67]. The payloads are "stellar-envelope-search-v1/" followed by one byte, 0x00 and 0x01 (decoded from the strkeys). The transaction failed (path_payment_strict_receive over_sendmax), so only the source GBZUB3ZC… changed (fee and sequence number); the operation source and destination GC2IXXCF… changed nothing. The extra signers are envelope-only and are not required of any reader. Written live by stellar-core 30.0.0.
